name: Toolbox
description: XP and daily stats. XP: session time, adventurer and producer pools, XP earned in the last hour; hover for XP Detailed with levels, progress bars, XP per hour and time to next level. Today: gold picked up, kills and XP since midnight; hover for every item gained today. Health & focus bars. Buff bar: your buffs and debuffs with a clock sweep, and optional sound alerts before a buff runs out and when a debuff lands (sound files you add to your Lua folder). Commands: /toolbox and /tbx.
author: shawn butts
